'''Thon Reemus''' was an employee of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who was assigned to the [[CZ-198]] research facility. A highly-trained individual with six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of field experience and millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of Czerka implants, Reemus was furious to be posted to CZ-198, where he was tasked with overseeing the facility's biological containment zones.<ref name="New posting" />
